description: FNPF 2D regular waves of fnpf_2d_regular (RK3) with the start values of the stage solves of the Laplace equation extrapolated in time, but the coarse levels of REEFMG built in every solve (A 321 1; the default is A 321 2). The solution is that of fnpf_2d_regular within the tolerance of the solves (N 44).
